title: 第520章 老乡
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我们没钱，我们哪有这么多钱？呜呜！他欠你们钱，找他就是了，抓我们做什么，抓我们有什么用？”

少妇则哭泣了起来，哭得很伤心，眼泪把身上的衣服都打湿了，黏糊糊的。

“妈妈！呜呜！我好怕。”

那少女更是哭泣得不行，抱着妈妈，她很害怕。

“大哥，看样子她们也不像有钱人，哎，白忙活了。”

一个小弟看了少妇和少女一眼，叹了口气，毕竟少妇和少女穿着打扮都是非常普通的，上面还打着补丁，一看就不是有钱的人样子，一看就是穷逼。

别说是200万美金，2000块美金估计她们都拿不出来。

听到小弟的话，这个光头老大也皱了皱眉，不知道怎么办了。

“大哥，她们两个好歹是女人，长得也不错，干脆卖到红灯区去，能卖多少是多少。”

一个小弟忽然提议道。

他这么说，其余的人也纷纷点头，光头老大也似乎想到了这一点，便猥琐的笑了。

毕竟在神帝城是有红灯区的，是男人寻欢作乐的地方。

“没错，你们两个长得也不错，既然没钱还那就去卖吧，什么时候把欠我们的钱还了就不用卖了，当然在卖之前先让我们兄弟们爽爽。”

光头汉子则看着这对母女笑嘻嘻地道。

他这么一说，他身边这群黑帮小弟更加开心了，每个人都露出了猥琐的笑容。

“你们不要乱来！”

看到他们的眼神，这对母女惊呆了，少妇更是将女儿挡在了身后，似乎想要保护女儿。

可惜她们只是两个弱女子，怎么能是这些饿狼的对手，不过就在这万分危机的时候，一个声音传来了。

“你们这群大男人，欺负两个弱女子，真是可以的。”

云峰从树上跳了下来，落在了他们的面前。

忽然出现的云峰，让这群地狱天使的人惊呆了，不明白云峰是从哪里出来的。

“大哥，是他？”

忽然间，一个地狱天使的小弟惊恐地动了起来。

“大哥，白天灭了山口组的人就是他，是云大人。”

这个小弟惊恐地道。

原来白天云峰在神帝城灭掉山口组的时候，很多人都看见了，这个地狱天使的小弟也在场，他自然

现在，他自然认出了云峰。

“啊，是他，他就是灭了山口组的那个狠人？”

得知云峰的情况后，这个光头老大也害怕了，今天山口组覆灭的场面他也是知道，山口组虽然比地狱天使弱一些，但是在神帝城也是赫赫有名的大帮派。

云峰能一个人灭了这么厉害的帮派，该有多强，一时间光头老大对云峰产生了畏惧感。

“既然是云大人要保护她们，那这件事就算了，我们走。”

光头大佬对着云峰陪着小心，就要招呼手下离开，毕竟他们可不敢得罪云峰大人，连山口组都能灭掉的狠人不是他们能招惹的。

“等等，我让你们走了吗？”

不过下一秒云峰的声音就传来了。

“怎么？”

光头老大疑惑地看着云峰，不明白云峰要做什么。

“呵呵，这两个女人是我同胞，刚才你们欺负我的同胞哪能这么算了，现在给我跪下给她们道歉，然后自断双腿，不然你们见不到明天的太阳。”

云峰淡淡地道，说出了狂妄的话。

"We have no money, how can we have so much money? Woohoo! He owes you money, just go to him. Why are you arresting us? What's the use of arresting us?"

The young woman began to cry so sadly that her clothes were all wet and sticky with her tears.

"Mom! Ouch! I'm so scared."

The girl cried so much that she hugged her mother. She was very scared.

"Brother, they don't look like rich people. Alas, all their hard work is in vain."

A young man glanced at the young woman and the girl and sighed. After all, the young woman and the girl were dressed very ordinary and had patches on them. At first glance, they looked like poor people instead of rich people.

Let alone 2 million U.S. dollars, they probably can't even come up with 2,000 U.S. dollars.

After hearing what the younger brother said, the bald boss also frowned and didn't know what to do.

"Brother, these two are women after all, and they are good-looking. We might as well sell them to the red light district for as much as they can."

A younger brother suddenly suggested.

When he said this, the rest of the people nodded, and the bald boss seemed to have thought of this, and smiled obscenely.

After all, there is a red light district in the Divine Emperor City, where men go to have fun.

"Yes, you two look good. Since you don't have the money to pay back, then sell it. You won't have to sell it when you pay back the money you owe us. Of course, let us brothers feel comfortable before selling it."

The bald man looked at the mother and daughter and said with a smile.

When he said this, the group of gangsters around him became even happier, and everyone showed a lewd smile.

"Don't mess around!"

Seeing their eyes, the mother and daughter were shocked. The young woman even blocked her daughter behind her, as if she wanted to protect her.

It's a pity that they are just two weak women, how can they be the opponents of these hungry wolves, but at this critical moment, a voice came.

"It's okay for you grown men to bully two weak women."

Yunfeng jumped down from the tree and landed in front of them.

The sudden appearance of Yunfeng shocked the Hells Angels and they didn't understand where Yunfeng came from.

"Brother, is it him?"

Suddenly, one of the Hells Angels boys started to move in fear.

"Brother, he was the one who killed the Yamaguchi group during the day, Mr. Yun."

The younger brother said in horror.

It turns out that when Yunfeng destroyed the Yamaguchi group in the Divine Emperor City during the day, many people saw it. This Hells Angel's younger brother was also present. Naturally, he

Now, he naturally recognized Yunfeng.

"Ah, it's him. He's the ruthless man who killed the Yamaguchi-gumi?"

After learning about Yunfeng's situation, the bald boss was also scared. He also knew the scene of the Yamaguchi-gumi's destruction today. Although the Yamaguchi-gumi was weaker than the Hell's Angels, it was also a famous gang in the God Emperor City.

How powerful Yunfeng must be to be able to destroy such a powerful gang by himself. For a moment, the bald boss felt afraid of Yunfeng.

"Since Master Yun wants to protect them, let's forget about it and let's go."

The bald man was careful with Yunfeng's company and wanted to tell his men to leave. After all, they did not dare to offend Master Yunfeng, and they were not someone they could offend against a ruthless person who could even be killed by the Yamaguchi group.

"Wait, did I let you go?"

But the next second Yunfeng's voice came.

"What?"

The bald boss looked at Yunfeng in confusion, not understanding what Yunfeng was going to do.

"Haha, these two women are my compatriots. You just bullied my compatriots. How can you let it go? Now kneel down and apologize to them, and then cut off your legs, otherwise you will not be able to see the sun tomorrow."

Yunfeng said calmly and said arrogant words.
